senses.sense_definition: The precise optical alignment of lenses or mirrors along a line of sight to minimize aberrations.

examples.text: Poor <w>collimation</w> of the telescope mirrors resulted in blurry images of the distant stars.
Astronomers regularly perform optical <w>collimation</w> to ensure their instruments capture sharp photographs.

senses.sense_definition: The process of making rays of light or particles parallel, or the state of being parallel.

examples.text: Proper beam <w>collimation</w> is essential to focus the radiation directly on the target.
The experiment required high <w>collimation</w> of the laser light across the laboratory bench.
